dark-sun-essentials.currency.ct.label: Ceramic Token
dark-sun-essentials.currency.cb.label: Ceramic Bit
dark-sun-essentials.currency.lb.label: Lead Bead
dark-sun-essentials.settings.ceramicCurr: Adds Ceramic Tokens, Ceramic Bits and Lead Beads, worth exactly what gold, silver and copper are worth. New items are priced in ceramic.
dark-sun-essentials.settings.removeLegac: Strips platinum, gold, electrum, silver and copper from the world. Requires Athasian coinage, and offers to convert existing balances first.
dark-sun-essentials.settings.psionicScho: Adds Psionic as a ninth school, so psionic powers can be filtered, listed and referenced like any other spell.
dark-sun-essentials.settings.psionicProp: Adds Psionic as a property on powers, weapons, gear, consumables and features, for marking anything of psionic origin. A descriptive tag — no automation.
dark-sun-essentials.settings.materialPro: Adds Wood, Bone, Stone, Obsidian and Metal as properties on weapons and armour. Descriptive tags only — no automation.
dark-sun-essentials.settings.siltVehicle: Adds Silt as a vehicle type, for skimmers on the Sea of Silt. Appears in the vehicle sheet's type list and as a vehicle proficiency.
dark-sun-essentials.migration.title: Convert Currency to Ceramic
dark-sun-essentials.migration.intro: This will fold every standard coin in the world into ceramic. Nothing is lost — the conversion is exact.
dark-sun-essentials.migration.introRemov: You are about to remove the standard coins. Convert what the world is currently holding first, or those balances become unreadable.
dark-sun-essentials.migration.rates: 1 pp becomes 10 ct · 1 gp becomes 1 ct · 1 ep becomes 5 cb · 1 sp becomes 1 cb · 1 cp becomes 1 lb
dark-sun-essentials.migration.compendium: {count} compendium packs are left untouched. Compendium content is not converted, because the next system update would undo it.
dark-sun-essentials.migration.skippedCoi: These coins could not be converted and have been left alone: {coins}
dark-sun-essentials.migration.remainder: {value} lead beads' worth of fractional value could not be represented and will be dropped.
dark-sun-essentials.migration.warning: This cannot be undone from inside Foundry. Back the world up first.
dark-sun-essentials.migration.keepAnyway: You chose not to convert. Removing the standard coins now will make any balance still held in them unreadable. Remove them anyway?
dark-sun-essentials.migration.errorsIntr: Most of the world converted, but these documents did not:
dark-sun-essentials.notify.incompatible: Dark Sun Essentials could not find the settings it needs in dnd5e {system}. Its features have been disabled rather than risk your data. See the console for detail.
dark-sun-essentials.notify.removalNeedsC: Enable Athasian coinage first — a world needs some currency to remove the standard coins in favour of.
dark-sun-essentials.notify.nothingToConv: Nothing to convert: no standard coin or pricing found in this world.
dark-sun-essentials.notify.migrationDone: Converted {actors} actors, {items} items and {tokens} unlinked tokens to ceramic coin.
dark-sun-essentials.notify.migrationPart: Currency migration finished, but {count} operations failed. See the console for detail.
dark-sun-essentials.notify.removalRevert: Standard coinage kept. The removal setting has been turned back off.
dark-sun-essentials.notify.untestedSyste: Dark Sun Essentials has not been tested against dnd5e {system}. It should still work, but check your coinage and item properties.
